`face_landmarker.task`: MediaPipe Face Landmarker (Face Mesh V2 + Blendshape V2), Apache-2.0 (model cards), 3.7 MB,
copied from `~/.cache/mediapipe/`; not in git. The runtime `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.14` (Apache-2.0) is loaded from
jsDelivr only by `?detect`/`__puppet.detect()`; the puppet itself needs no third-party code at all.
